sentences.en: It was an exciting story and he told it well.
sentences.zh: 这真是个激动人心的故事，他讲得非常好。

sentences.en: I had never seen such an exciting baseball game before.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未见过如此精彩的棒球比赛。

sentences.en: They found it exciting to play baseball on the playground.
sentences.zh: 他们在操场上打棒球觉得很兴奋。

senses.zh: 令人兴奋的；使人激动的
